name: cintake-submission-prospect-response
description: The receipt vocabulary for the sixth form kind: a CIntakeSubmission.form option 'Prospect Response' so a postcard landing-page response classifies on its receipt (core/receipts._FORM_VALUES). Without it the receipt is still written, without its form (core/receipts.py logs a warning). Additive; crm-test first, production at the Sunday slot with coutreach-entities.json. Found while building Phase 1 (10-15-26).
